query:
-- Clientes ativos SEM cotas (não deveriam ver mensagem de erro, mas podem)
SELECT 
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.email,
  ac.name,
  'ATIVO SEM COTA' AS situacao
FROM allowed_clients ac
LEFT JOIN client_quotas cq ON cq.client_id = ac.id AND cq.is_active = 1
WHERE ac.is_active = 1 AND cq.id IS NULL

UNION ALL

-- Clientes INATIVOS com cotas ativas (causa raiz do bug)
SELECT 
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.email,
  ac.name,
  'INATIVO COM COTA' AS situacao
FROM allowed_clients ac
INNER JOIN client_quotas cq ON cq.client_id = ac.id AND cq.is_active = 1
WHERE ac.is_active = 0
GROUP BY ac.id, ac.email, ac.name

ORDER BY situacao, name;
